hexa.notes: The only Night Walker HEXA investment order reachable publicly is a pair of images: 'HEXA Leveling Order - Fragment Limited' and 'HEXA Leveling Order - Energy Limited', credited on Grandis Library to the Night Walker Discord and file-dated 2026-09-04. There is no public Night Walker class document - maplestorywiki's Guide:Class Guides index shows a Night Walker heading with no link, and Grandis Library's Other Resources block for this class links only maplestorywiki, NamuWiki and the Discord (no Class Doc). Both charts carry the subtitle 'Updated for HEXA Common Core (October 2026)', which is AFTER the v.271 target patch, and both include a Common Node named 'HEXA Phalanx Charge' that does not appear anywhere on maplestorywiki's Night Walker skills page as of 2026-09-11 - so these charts appear to be written for a HEXA Common Core change that may not be live in GMS at v.271. Treat the ordering as provisional and re-verify against the Discord. Node names appearing on the charts, all validated against maplestorywiki except HEXA Phalanx Charge: Skill Nodes - Silence, Stygian Command. Mastery Nodes - HEXA Quintuple Star (a 'HEXA Quintuple Star [Jet Black Throwing Stars]' variant also exists on the wiki), HEXA Shadow Bat, HEXA Ravenous Bat, HEXA Dark Omen, HEXA Dominion, Abyssal Darkness. Enhancement Nodes - Shadow Spear, Greater Dark Servant, Shadow Slide, Shadow Bite, Rapid Throw (exactly Night Walker's five class-specific 5th job skills on the wiki). Common Nodes - Sol Hecate (chart notes the icon changes at levels 20 and 30), HEXA Phalanx Charge. HEXA Stats appear as Node 1 / Node 2 / Node 3 with no stat-line recommendation attached, so no Night-Walker-specific HEXA Stat line advice could be sourced. Sol Janus appears in maplestorywiki's shared HEXA skill list for the class but does not appear on either chart. Only the first steps of each chart were transcribed; the full charts run to roughly 200 steps and remain the authoritative artifact.

innerAbility.notes: No attack-speed inner ability line appears in either preset. That is consistent with Grandis Library's own stat table, which puts Night Walker's attack speed at Stage 8 including +2 from Agile Throwing (2nd Job) on a Stage 6 base - i.e. the class reaches its attack speed ceiling from its own kit - but no source states outright that the attack-speed line is therefore unnecessary for Night Walker, so that inference is flagged here rather than asserted. The cross-class inner ability framework on maplestorywiki's Inner Ability guide (Legendary top line first, lines 2 and 3 left alone until late game, 20% Mesos Obtained for the training preset) is the general rule these presets sit inside; it is not Night-Walker-specific.

gearingNotes: CRITICAL RATE: Night Walker gets +40% crit rate from its own kit - 5% base plus 35% from Critical Throw (2nd Job). Dominion (Hyper Skill active) adds +100% crit rate, but only for its 20-second window on a 120-second cooldown, so the class is crit-capped inside its burst and sits at 40% from skills outside it; the remaining ~60% for off-burst has to come from links, legion, hyper stats, inner ability and gear. Three boost nodes add crit at node level 20 (Quintuple Star Boost +5%, Shadow Stitch Boost +5%, Lucky Seven Boost +5%), and the unpicked hyper passive Quintuple Star - Critical Chance would add +10% to that skill. Sources: Grandis Library base stats table, maplestorywiki. IGNORE DEF: +44.75% from the kit, built as Dark Blessing (4th Job) +15% stacked multiplicatively with Adaptive Darkness III (+7% per stack, max +35%). Lucky Seven Boost adds Ignored Enemy Defense +20% at node level 40, though Grandis Library tiers that node lowest. Source: Grandis Library, maplestorywiki. BOSS DAMAGE: +0% from the class's own passives - Grandis Library's base stats table lists boss damage with an empty source list. Every point of boss damage is external (gear, potentials, legion, hyper stats, inner ability, and the Quintuple Star - Boss Rush hyper passive, which is boss damage on one skill only). Source: Grandis Library. ATTACK SPEED: Grandis Library lists Stage 8, from a Stage 6 base plus +2 from Agile Throwing (2nd Job). WEAPON: Claw primary, Jewel secondary, Throwing Stars as ammunition; weapon multiplier 1.75x; weapon mastery 85% (base 15% plus Throwing Expert +70%), the thief mastery cap. LUK FROM SKILLS: +80 flat (Agile Throwing +20, Physical Training +60), +1 per 2 character levels from Elemental Harmony, and +15% of assigned AP from Call of Cygnus. DARK ATTRIBUTE: every Night Walker attack is dark-attribute, including the Dark Servant / Shadow Illusion / Greater Dark Servant clones, the Shadow Bats and Ravenous Bats, and Shadow Spears; in 5th job, landing dark-attribute attacks is what builds Shadow Spear. MapleDoro describes Night Walker as the only Cygnus class with Dark Sight (used to dodge boss attacks); that claim comes from a dependent source and was not independently verified here. Final damage from skills is a point of numeric disagreement between sources - see conflicts.

sourcingCaveat: This file does NOT meet the three-independent-judgement-sources bar, and should not be shipped with the same confidence as a class that does. Night Walker has no public class document: maplestorywiki's class guide index has an empty Night Walker entry, and Grandis Library's Night Walker page carries no Class Doc link. Every current judgement claim here - boost node tiering, hyper passive build, both inner ability presets, and both HEXA leveling orders - traces to a single source family: the Night Walker Discord, presented through Grandis Library and its Discord-credited infographics. Only two independent judgement sources were reachable: that Discord family, and mystyjl's node reference, which is from 2024 and conflicts with the current node grouping. maplestorywiki is a genuine third independent source but carries facts and names only, no recommendations; it was used throughout as a name-validation allowlist, so no node or skill name in this file is unverified - with the single flagged exception of HEXA Phalanx Charge, which appears on the HEXA charts but not on the wiki. Reddit was not reachable in this environment and was not consulted; the web search budget for the session was exhausted before this pass began, so discovery ran through direct fetches and a YouTube listing rather than general search. No 2025-or-later written Night Walker guide exists outside that Discord family as far as this pass could determine. To close the gap, someone needs to read the Night Walker Discord (discord.gg/FR55ADj) directly, and to check r/Maplestory for any Night Walker HEXA discussion.
